title: Prove Int cut lemmas by one split that z3 finds
summary: Integer cut and lattice lemmas are now proved in Lean by one case split whose form, constant, and multipliers z3 finds as an untrusted oracle, with the old tactic proofs kept as a fallback. With two memory fixes, the 20-variable QF_LIA benchmark cut_lemma_02_002 verifies end to end for the first time.
